text: Treatment plan TP-0001 for patient PAT-001. Diagnosis: hypertension management. Plan: lisinopril 20mg daily, amlodipine 5mg daily, lifestyle modifications including DASH diet and 150 min/week exercise. Follow-up scheduled in 2 weeks. Initiated by Dr. Smith.

Treatment plan TP-0002 for patient PAT-002. Diagnosis: type 2 diabetes. Plan: metformin 1000mg BID, empagliflozin 10mg daily, A1c target <7%, glucose monitoring QID. Follow-up scheduled in 3 weeks. Initiated by Dr. Anderson.

Treatment plan TP-0003 for patient PAT-003. Diagnosis: CHF management. Plan: carvedilol 25mg BID, lisinopril 40mg daily, furosemide 40mg daily, fluid restriction 1.5L/day, daily weight. Follow-up scheduled in 4 weeks. Initiated by Dr. Lee.

Treatment plan TP-0004 for patient PAT-004. Diagnosis: anticoagulation therapy. Plan: warfarin 5mg daily, target INR 2.0-3.0, weekly INR monitoring, avoid NSAIDs and green leafy vegetable excess. Follow-up scheduled in 5 weeks. Initiated by Dr. Patel.

Treatment plan TP-0005 for patient PAT-005. Diagnosis: COPD management. Plan: tiotropium 18mcg inhaled daily, fluticasone/salmeterol 250/50 BID, albuterol PRN, annual pneumonia and flu vaccines. Follow-up scheduled in 6 weeks. Initiated by Dr. Chen.

Treatment plan TP-0006 for patient PAT-006. Diagnosis: post-MI care. Plan: aspirin 81mg daily, clopidogrel 75mg daily x12 months, atorvastatin 80mg daily, metoprolol succinate 50mg daily, cardiac rehab. Follow-up scheduled in 7 weeks. Initiated by Dr. Garcia.

Treatment plan TP-0007 for patient PAT-007. Diagnosis: chronic pain management. Plan: duloxetine 60mg daily, physical therapy 2x/week, acetaminophen 1000mg TID PRN, avoid opioids per pain contract. Follow-up scheduled in 2 weeks. Initiated by Dr. Wilson.
